items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] A TV star? ... [INTERVIEWEE] In those days? Back in 1930-31?

ctx.x: Well, there's a guy, there's a star in California now that used to play with one of those bands. He's the star of one of the television shows, they played out of Cincinat with one of those bands.
